approach.title: Giving people the means to move forward, not just aid
approach.text: Three complementary levers, designed with communities, for changes that last beyond our programmes.

training.title: Training
training.text: Management, basic bookkeeping, farming techniques, entrepreneurship: we pass on the skills that make an activity sustainable.

microfinance.title: Solidarity microfinance
microfinance.text: Microcredits at solidarity rates, with monthly follow-up. Every loan repaid funds a new activity.

solidarity.text: Cooperatives, village savings groups, mentoring: the strength of the group protects families when the unexpected happens.

join.title: Get involved with us
join.lead: Volunteers, members, professionals: everyone can help Cameroonian families become self-reliant, according to their time and skills.

volunteer.text: Give a few hours: welcoming the public at fundraising events, supporting workshops, logistics, communication.

responsibility.title: Skills and responsibilities
responsibility.text: Finance, communication, IT, regional coordination: put your skills to work for the project.
